sanskrit: adharmo bhedavijñeyā cittavṛttiprabhedataḥsvāpe vibhāgamabhyeti tatsṛṣṭāvupayujyateprārabdhaṃ sañcitaṃ karma āgāmi ca tridhā bhavetkañcukatrividhaṃ viddhaṃ kālena kalitaṃ śanaiḥsṛṣṭikālaḥ sthiteḥ kāla saṃhāraśca tridhā matāyadā śeṣasamāptantu tadāditamiti smṛtamasamāptaṃ yadārabdhaṃ vartamānamudāhṛtamsamyak jñānaṃ tapo maunaṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛti kṣamāḥdarpaṃ mahadahaṃkāraṃ viṣādā priyavācakamālasyaṃ mohanidrā ca cāpalyaṃ hīnavṛttikamprakṛte guṇatatvantu bhidyate na ca tatvataḥvibhaktaguṇasāmyantu guṇatatvamihocyatetiryaktvaṃ tāmasaḥ prāyāt ityeṣā trividhā gatiḥahaṃkāratridhā proktaṃ jīvasaṃraṃbhagarvakampañcakarmakṛto vāyo jīvanāya pravartakaḥkaḥ kartā kriyate tasya yatkṛtaṃ jagato mayāsa ca trividhamuddiṣṭaḥ prathamastatra tejasaḥsatvenotkṛṣṭabhāvo ya svatejasa ihocyatebhūtānāmādi bhūtatvāt bhūtādiriti kathyateśuddhāvasthānamātmānaṃ śivavaktuṃ na saṃśayaḥacetanasya māyādeḥ pravartakatayā patiḥsādhakānāṃ hitārthāya svecchayā gṛhyate tanumsakalañca tathā śāstro tribhedaṃ vidyate kramātparāparaṃ tathā proktaṃ bhavetsakalaniṣkalamlayabhogādhikārañca tribhedaṃ vidyate kramāt

sanskrit: pūrvasmin sthāpite tasmin ajñāte pūrvamandiretrividhaṃ liṅgamityuktaṃ vyaktāvyaktobhayātmakamjñānajyotirmayaṃ liṅgaṃ vyaktāvyaktamiti smṛtamcalaṃ nijātmani pūjyaṃ bāṇaliṅgaṃ calācalamanantasya śiraḥ kaṃpāt kālāgneḥ kopamucyatenirmūlañca samūlañca supūrvakamiti smṛtamāptavākyaṃ supūrvaṃ syāt svāyambhuvamiti stridhākarkaśaṃ suṣirādyaiśca niyataṃ dṛśyate bhuviśirasodvartanaṃ tadvat sūtravartanameva capīṭhaprāsādikaṃ tastu liṅgamānādvidhīyatedṛśyabhāgamadhastāttu mūlaliṅgaṃ na śodhayetkartṛśca grāmavāsīnāṃ rājñasyānnāśayettu tatcitraṃ citrārdhakaṃ caiva citrābhāsamiti stridhāardhāvayava saṃdṛśyaṃ madhyacitramihocyateāsanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cāruvanānalapātālādi parāṃtaṃ syāttadakhaṇḍaṃ praśasyateśaktyādīni śivāntā syāt tattuṇḍamiti kīrtitamkṣaṇike calaliṅge ca tuṇḍamevaṃ prakalpayetbhitticitrādikaṃ caiva tuṇḍaliṅgaṃ praśasyateupāṃśuyajane proktaṃ vācikaṃ homakarmaṇiyajanaṃ trividhaṃ proktamuttamaṃ madhyamādhamamvaidikaiśśivamaṃtraistu yajanaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavettasmāttu śaivikairmantraiḥ yajedātmārthamuttamamkevalaiśśuddhaśaivoktai mantrairuttamamucyateśaivamantrasamaṃ maṃtraṃ nāstīti bhuvanatraye

sanskrit: vaidikaṃ miśrakaṃ śaivamagnikāryaṃ tridhāmatammaṃtrairvaidikaśaivastu vihito miśra ucyatevaidikaṃ brāhmaṇānāntu rājñāṃ vaidikatantrikaḥmantrantu trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ mālābījaṃ padakramātśuddhamekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ miśramekākṣaraṃ bhavethrasvadīrghaplutā mātra ekadvitri kramādviduḥtrimātrastu pluto jñeyo vyañjanaṃttvardhamātrakamdvādaśāntasamāyuktaṃ prāsādaṃ mantraśuddhayeāpyāyate plutañcaiva bindunā mūrdhni bhūṣitamplutaṃ hi sadā vaśyaṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥādāvaṃte va hrasvasya ṣaṭkāro māraṇe hitaḥbrāhmaṇī hrasvanī proktaṃ dīrghasyāṃgāni ṣaṇmukhasthūlasūkṣmaparaṃ jñatvā karma kuryādyathepsitamcintāyā sahitaṃ yattu tatparaṃ parikīrtitamprāsādaṃ yena budhyanti tena budhyanti śaṅkaraḥaṣṭattriṃśatkalāyuktaṃ na sa ācārya ucyateadhasthācchiṣyamātmānaṃ na dagdhe nātra saṃśayaḥācāryassaha śiṣyaistu śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajettasmānmantrakriyārthatvāt mantraṃ hitvā kriyā na hisnānamācamanaṃ mantraiḥ mantreṇāhutirtarpaṇammantreṇa tu aṇimādīni sālokādi ca saṃbhavetmānanaṃ sarvaveditvāt trāṇasaṃsārasāgarātśuddhaṃ kevalasaṃmiśraṃ ātmārthaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetsaurādi caṇḍaparyantaṃ miśraṃ cettu prakīrtitamkevalaṃ liṅgamekaṃ syāt sahajaṃ pañcaberakam

sanskrit: gaṇeśa skandaberañca śaktiśca vṛṣabhaṃ tathāsahajena samāyuktaṃ maheśaṃ nṛttamūrtinamjitendriyārcitaṃ śuddhaṃ śaivaṃ kevalamarcayetsthiraliṅge sadākāryaṃ siddhikāmaiḥ prayatnataḥśuddhaṃ miśrā ca saṃkīrṇā parārthe tu tridhā matāsaṅkīrṇā śuddhanṛttāntaṃ pūjāttrividhamucyateśuddhamiśrā prakūrvīta saṅkīrṇeva viśeṣataḥmiśrasaṅkīrṇayoḥ prāptiḥ neṣyate tatra jānanaḥśuddhaṃ miśrañca saṅkīrṇaṃ pūjā ca trividhaṃ bhavetsaṅkīrṇaṃ pañcamūrtīnāṃ parārthaṃ trividhā matādurgāśatṛjayārthañca viśeṣātputrakāmyadamātmārthaṃ pūjayedvidvān yathā śaktyānurodhatāṃdīpāntamarcanaṃ proktaṃ naivedyāntantu pūjanamsāvaśyaṃ dīpatoyāntaṃ saubhāgyaṃ haviṣāntakamdīpāntamarcanaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ vai kanyasatrayamstotrāntaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ phalaṃ vai kanyasatrayamprāṇāgnihotrasaphalaṃ navadhā caiva tatphalamhomāntamutsavāntañca stotrāntaṃ madhyamatrayamuttamatrayamākhyātaṃ pūjāphalamaharddhidamtrividhā nṛttabhedāstu kathitā nṛttavedibhiḥrudrakanyā prakartavyā nānyeṣāntu kadācanatīrthāṃkuratṛtīyantu tṛtīyañcotsavāṅkuramtṛtīyaṃ cotsavāṅgaṃ syāt aṅkuraṃ trividhaṃ bhavetbherītāḍanapūrvañca aṅkurārpaṇapūrvakambherītāḍanapūrvantu taddine dviguṇaṃ matam

sanskrit: śivotsavāraṃbhakāle tu neṣṭamanyotsavaṃ guhapurārabdhānyadevānāṃ utsavaṃ na ca doṣabhākśivāṅgañcānyayāgañca ekakāle kṛtaṃ yadidhvajañcānyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajamkārayedyadi mohena vyādhiroga bhayaṃ bhavetdivasaṃ pratyanuṣṭheyaṃ taṃ nityamiha kathyatedīkṣā caiva pratiṣṭhā ca naimittikamidaṃ bhavetkāmyañca siddhayo jñeyā siddhayo bahudhā smṛtāḥuttamaṃ khesaratvañca śreṣṭhadevasamānataḥvidyeśatvañca rudratvaṃ brahmatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padamaparaṃ tatparaṃ vidyādanantādi padasthitaḥnityanaimittike kuryāt pratyavāyajigāṃkṣayākartavyaṃ vā na kartavyaṃ iti saṃdehasaṃgatautasmāttāvattu śaivoktaṃ kartavyamanyaśāstrataḥtadvitānupapanne ca tatrā pṛṣṭha vidhīyatevartamāne tu śāstrārthe tadaṅgaṃ sruk sruvādikamevamādikamālocya kārayedye nṛpottamāḥtasyāpyāyuṣamārogyaṃ manasā kalpitaṃ ca yatviparītakriyāṃ dṛṣṭvāpyaudāsīnyaṃ karoti yaḥtasmādācārya yuktañca pañcagocaravartmanākriyā nṛvṛttanīyā syāt svasvarāṣṭrābhivṛddhayetenaiva snapanādyantu kārayet munisattamaḥguruṇāpi trayaṃ kāryaṃ sthāpanena vinā sutamnityaṃ kāmyaṃ sādhakasya svaśāstroktaṃ ṣaḍānanaprāksandhyā saṃyutastasya viśiṣṭasyāhnikaṃ dvayam

sanskrit: ācāryasya viśeṣeṇa arddharātrau vidhīyateekaiva vastuta śaivī yā śaktī nirmalā parātayātmaśivayossandhi śivabodhaparāparāyāstu kriyā dṛgiścākhyaśaktayaśśuddhavartmanisā saṃdhyā bindunādāntaṃ śamanā śaktikāminīnirvāṇadīkṣitairdhyāyahṛtphālakapileṣu caguṇatrayānvitā brāhmī vaiṣṇavī śāṃkarī tathāapare vai samākhyāta samaścaiva putrakaiḥevaṃ saṃdhyāstadāścaṇḍa ca sākṣiṇaḥ sarvakarmaṇāmādityā vasavorudrā sādhyāśca marutastathāaṃgirāścāśvinī devāstathā stridevatā gaṇāḥtatvānāṃ patayaścaiva uttamāḥ parikīrtitāḥyakṣa vidyādharaścaiva prajānāṃ patayastathābhūtā pretā piśācāśca kuśmāṇḍā prathamā apikinnarāścaiva vetālā apasmāragṛhādayaḥlihinyāścaiva sarveṣu jaghanyāḥ parikīrtitaḥrudrālayondadā proktā parivāreṣu kīrtitāḥjarjopsu saṃpadasya tryaṅgulaṃ caraṇā smṛtamtatpārti dvayamadhyāttu parijñeya vibhāgakamraudraṃ tadvatyayā jñeyā manayorlakṣaṇaṃ samamraudraṃ nivṛttiṃ rāgāṇāṃ sthānamārgapradarśitamparātparatarañcaiva trividhaṃ parikīrtitammūlāvatārataṃtrāṇi śāstraṃ yat vāmaśaivakamkāmikādīni tantrāṇi siddhāntaṃ śaivamucyateekadvibahusaṃkhyānaḥ prayoktavyāḥ krameṇa tu

sanskrit: liṅgārthamātre prathamā tathā ca mantraṇoditāapadāne ca saṃbandhe tathā nirddharuno hitāḥ ?ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī yojya saptamyarthe tu sā punaḥarthānusārato yojyaḥ kārakāssapta karmabhiḥvyākhyā kāryā prayatnena pade vākye samāhitaḥapaśabdastu tat jñeyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtepi caāgamādyapaśabdāni varṇayanti vidurbudhaḥavidyārāgavākyena saṃsārakleśahetunāviśiṣṭamapi tadvākyaṃ vijñeyamatiśobhanamvacanatrayayogena pratyekaṃ kavayo viduḥasmaduttamaśabde tu dhātumādau nirupayetvartamānādi kāryeṣu prayogaṃ cātra nirdiśetvyañjanāni svarāścaiva saṃdhayo'tha vibhaktayaḥtairaṅgaṃ vividhānaistu nānā dhātuvivakṣitamvibhaktyantapadaṃ jñeyaṃ śabdaśāstraviśāradaiḥnirbandhantu padaṃ jñeyaṃ pramāṇaṃ niyatātmakamsamaṃ cārdhasamañcaiva tathā viṣayameva caaṅghayoryastu catvārastulyalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥprathamāṅghrisamo yasya tṛtīyaścaraṇo bhavetyasya pādacatuṣkepi lakṣmabhinnaṃ parasparamatibandhapadaśchedaṃ tadā cāniyatākṣarampadyaṃ gadyañca miśrañca tattridhaiva vyavasthitamapādaṃ padasandarbhaṃ jñātvā tatkriyate kaviḥstrīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ kāvyaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamudāhṛtamklībaṃ caivādhamaṃ jñātvā tatkriyate kaviḥ

sanskrit: anye gaṇāśca te sarve klībāste te prakīrtitāḥantaḥkaraṇa sāpekṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetcicchaktyāssarvabhāvānāṃ yogasvābhiviko mataḥindriyāpekṣayā śaktyā tadvāreṇārthavīkṣaṇampakṣidharmasapakṣāsadvyāvṛttaśca vipakṣitaḥsādhyadharmayutaḥ pakṣassapakṣassamadharmayuksandhyānvayo strī rūpatvaṃ pretā satpratipakṣatāsāṃ nirdeśaḥ samūdhūtvādanyo rasapatiryathāyatayastrividhā jñeya tapasvī vivarṣastathātaponiṣṭhāstapasvīti tasya vṛttistu saṃvṛtaśiṣyāṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ caiva naiva vidyāprakāśanamliṅgaṃ kṣaṇikamabhyarcya bhaktimātreṇa saṃyutaḥanādbhīti samāyukte vasedbāhūpadhānakaḥpāṇipātrota pātre vā yācitānena jīvanamviduṣośca yateścāpi vartanaṃ nandikeśvaraetaccatuṣṭayaṃ tasya viduṣośca viśeṣataḥsadācāryābhiṣekeṇa na muktodyatsamākhyakaḥāśramāṇāntu bhedosti niṣṭhā bhedo na vidyateeka phaladvayaṃ bhuṅkte mokṣārthadhāraṇastayoḥpaśuḥ pāśaḥ patiścaiva śivaśceti yathākramamsamūḍho nityasaṃsārī kiñcijño'niśvaro kriyaḥsahajā sarvajantūnāṃ tāmrakālikavatsthitaupatissadāśivo jñeyo mantrātmā mantravigrahaḥvaikharī madhyamācānyā paśyantī sūkṣmasaṃjñakānirvikalpā tṛtīyā ca ādyāṃ karaṇamantimā

sanskrit: paśyantyāḥ karaṇaṃ sūkṣmā nirvikalpā svarūpiṇīantarāvasthitāstisro bahiranyā vyavasthitāḥsaṅghoṣaṃ ghoṣarahitaṃ bindukṣobhayaṃ catuṣṭayamsaiṣā caturvidhā vṛtti nivṛtyādi kalāśrayaḥṛgyajussāmātharvaṇa vedāścatvāra īritāḥcatvāryetānyupāṅgāni bahiraṅgāni tāni vaigāṃdharvavedaścetyevaṃ upavedāścaturvidhāḥdharmaśramānurūpeṇa dharmādharmavibhāgataḥhetu liṅgauṣadhaskandhairāyurārogya darśakamarthavedonnapānādi pradhānamuta tatparaḥtatpālanāt caturvaktra puruṣārtha prasādakamsaptasvaraprayogaṃ hi sāmagandharvavedayoḥbauddhamārhatanañcaiva pāñcarātrañca śaivakamśāstraṃ caturvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ vāmadakṣiṇamiśrakamvāmādi śāstrabhedeṣu ye dīkṣāṃ vartite kramātvāmāṃ hi śāṃbhavaṃ śāstraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bhairavātmikamsiddhāntaṃ sarvasāraṃ hi śuddhaśaivamiti smṛtamśaivabāhyāssamākhyātāste tu śaivepyapūjitāḥkarmāntamevaṃ jñānāntaṃ śaivamūrdhvaṃ paraṃ smṛtamcaryā kriyā yogayuktaṃ jñāninaśca bhavettadāsarvatantramayaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvamantramayaṃ bhavetdeśiko maṃtravṛttiśca putrakaḥ samayī ca saḥsarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ śivamantraniṣevaṇambrahmaṇakṣatriyo vaiśyo strīśūdrovāśramī tathāvānaprasthaśca ityete āśramāśca udāhṛtāḥ

sanskrit: śivagotraṃ śikhāgotraṃ jyotirgotraṃ tṛtīyakamlokānugrahakartāro śaivā jñeyā na cetaredadhīcī sthāpitaṃ sthānaṃ govidāramiti smṛtamtasmādvinirgataṃ sthānaṃ raṇabhadrañca golakambrahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathāsanyāsāśramamatyantamuttamaṃ dīkṣito bhavetdīkṣākhya jñānasaṃsparśāt loke muktimukhā dvijāḥdānaṃ pātre pradātavyaṃ na pātrepyaṇumātrakamtaddānaṃ nityamityuktaṃ devadevena śaṃbhunāproktaṃ naimittikaṃ dānaṃ ṛṣibhirvedavādibhiḥyaddānaṃ dīyate bhaktyā kāmyamityabhidhīyatedānaṃ tadvimaṃ proktaṃ kevalaṃ mokṣasādhanamsthāpakenoditaṃ (sarvaṃ) śivaśāstreṇa nirdiśetmayasya tanayastasya sūtragrāhīti kīrtitaḥmānoḥ putrastakṣakākhyo stapatyādi catuṣṭayaḥsūtragrāhī ca mānajño dravyayāñco ca vardhakīchedye ca chedayetsarvān bhedye tu dravyabhedakaḥsthapatissūtragrāhī ca prāsādātpratimādikānśeṣe tu varjayettatra mantrakarmasu sarvadāsthavire te śilpikārye sthāpakasyānusārataḥna hīnāṅgo'tiraktāṅgo dharmiṣṭhaḥ satyavācakaḥīdṛśaṃ śilpinaṃ grāhyaṃ prārabhetsarvakantakamdaivikaṃ cārṣakaṃ caiva gāṇavaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathādīrghākāraṃ bhavelliṅgaṃ nimnonnatasamanvitamparvatāgraṃ kṛtaṃ randhaṃ bahugranthiśikhāyutam

sanskrit: ityete lakṣaṇairyuktaṃ daivikaṃ liṅgamucyatemadhyasthūlantu liṅgantu nālikeraphalākṛtimtalliṅgamārṣamākhyātaṃ brahmasūtravivarjitamurvārukaphalākāraṃ kapitthaphalasannibhamdvāraṃ vā garbhamānaṃ vā hastamānaṃ yathāpi vāetadvarṇaṃ śiro snigdhaṃ brahmasūtrasamanvitamprathamaṃ sarvato bhadraṃ dvitīyaṃ vartamānakamevaṃ caturvidhaṃ liṅgaṃ mahāliṅgamitīritamcatuṣṣaṣṭividhaṃ liṅgaṃ samāsātparikīrtitammahāliṅgamiti proktaṃ dhārāliṅgaṃ sahasrakamśivādhikyaṃ vesarañca trairāśikantu miśrakamdhārāliṅgasahasrāṇi miśrake sthāpayedbudhaḥyānantu devikādīnāṃ mātuṣyaṃ sthānakaṃ viduḥvartamānasthitaṃ liṅgamāsanañca śivādhikamśirasodvartanaṃ tatra caturvidhamidaṃ bhavetkhaṇḍendu sadṛśākāraṃ budbudākārameva caviśāṃ khaṇḍendusadṛśaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ kukkuṭāṇḍavatsarvaviprasya nirdiṣṭaṃ chatrākāratrayaṃ nṛpeśūdrāṇāmekamevoktaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍanibhaṃ haredaśopacāradīpāntaṃ haviṣyantañca ṣoḍaśamāvāhanādi pādyādi tathaivācamārghyakamdaśopacāramityevaṃ dīpāntantu śivārcanamsnānaṃ vastropavītañca bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhapuṣpakamṣoḍaśaivopacārañca haviṣyantantu pūjanampādyamācamanīyārghyaṃ navavastrottarīyakam

sanskrit: nīrāñjanañca bhasmā ca cāmaraṃ tālavṛntakamnaivedyaṃ homakarmañca balidānañca pañcadhāudakañcāpyamudvāhaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupacārakamśirovaktañca hṛdayamaṅgañceti prakīrtitamūrujānudvayañcaiva pratyaṃgaṃ ceti kīrtitamjaṭāmakuṭakañcaiva sāṅgaṃ ceti prakīrtitamsakalānāntu sarveṣāṃ kartavyo bālabiṃbakejānvantaṃ kanyasaṃproktaṃ vāhvantaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetpratimāṃ vāpi pīṭhaṃ vā devāgre sthāpayedbudhaḥpratyaṅgādīni sarveṣāṃ chinnabhinne ca saṃbhaverahasyaṃ kalpayettatra punassandhānamācaretpūrvavat śaktisahitaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kārayedbudhaḥutsavādīni sarvāṇi kṛtañcedrākṣasāspadamtasmātsarvaprayatnena jīrṇamuddhṛtya kārayetdarśāntaḥ paurṇamānte ca cāndramāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥaśvinyādi ca paurṇāntaṃ māsanakṣatramīritamsāvanenaiva kartavya bhṛtyānāṃ vedanaṃ tathāsāvanaṃ cāndranakṣatraṃ māseṣu śaktimaṃgalaumuktidaṃ cāndramāse tu nakṣatraṃ pāpanāśanamtithipradhānatīrthāntaṃ cāndramāsoktamuttamamsāvane cotsavaṃ jñeyaṃ sā pratiṣṭhotsavaṃ guhajñātvā pariharettadvat sa tīrtharkṣeścedvijottamaḥneṣṭaṃ prathamarkṣe tu anyarkṣe tīrthamācarettasmātsarvaprayatnena tīrthamanyarkṣamācarettatañca vitatañcaiva ghanaṃ suṣirameva ca

sanskrit: ghanañca kāṃsyatālādyaṃ vaṃśādisuṣiraṃ tathāsaṃsṛṣṭañca balimnaśca vikṣipecca gatāgatiḥna ca tairyujyate jñānaṃ tatsaṃsṛṣṭimudāhṛtamsvalīno viṣayairmukta ekībhūta suṣuptivattrikālamākulo nityaṃ sa tu vikṣipta ucyatecalate yasya dorbalyāt tasyāsau ca gatāgatiḥmadhyamassa tu vijñeyassaṃhṛṣṭassātviko mataḥtāmasassa tu vikṣipta caturtho hyadhamo yataḥetaccatuṣṭayaṃ jñātvā yogaṃ yuñjīta yogavatśivabhaktassadotsāhī dhyātoyaṃ puruṣasmṛtaḥjñānena pariśuddhena jñānadhyānamiti smṛtiḥnānārūpavikalpena dhyeyassiddhyarthamīśvaraḥityete dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ śivadhyānaprayojanamsanmārgassaha mārgañca pitṛmārgaṃ tathā paraḥcaryāmārgaṃ dāsamārgaṃ putramārgaṃ kramādviduḥdāsamārgaṃ śivo dhyānaṃ liṅgabiṃbālayādi kṛtputramārgī śivārcādi japahomaparāyaṇaḥsahamārgī bhavetsaiva śaivāgamaviśāradāḥsanmārgītyukta saṃsārī samatvaśucimatvayuketaccaturvidhaṃ mārgaṃ sālokyādi phalapradamdhyānāllokantu saṃprāpya sālokyaṃ tadvidhīyatetattaddrūpasya saṃprāptiḥ tatsārūpyamiti smṛtamgalite sarvadā bandhe vimukte cāṇave balesarvatra dyotikāśakti śivasyeva vijṛṃbhatesūkṣmabhinne (kala) kalaśceti pañcadhāvasthitaśśivaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00254 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niṣkalaḥ kevalo bindoradhyāpi sakala niṣkalaḥsvarairṣoḍaśabhirbhinno bhinnātmā bindurīritaḥavasthitañca sarvatra tenāsau sakalasmṛtaḥniṣprapañco nirābhāso vimalo niṣkalaśśivaḥnidānakalayātītaḥ sa vai niṣkala ucyateparaṃ tattu vijānīyāt rūpaṃ sakalaniṣkalamprerate ca jagatsarvaṃ sa vai sūkṣmaḥ prakīrtitaḥbhidyate yastu bahudhā sakalo bhinna ucyatepaśuvāgīśvaro vidyayonimuktiribhāntimaprathamaṃ śivasādākhyaṃ amūrtintu dvitīyakampañcamaṃ karma sādākhyaṃ iti sādākhyapañcakamnādaṃ binduriti jñeyaṃ bindupīṭhamudāhṛtamcatvāri kartṛrūpādi kevalaṃ nādamucyatekartṛsādākhyarūpaṃ hi sa mūrtyādīn samāśritamkarmeśaṃ pūrvavaktraṃ syāt kartussavyānanaṃ bhavetūrdhvantu śivasādākhyamevaṃ pañcānanaṃ viduḥsvayambhuśśivasādākhyaṃ bāṇaliṅgamamūrtikammaheśaṃ mūrtisādākhyaṃ pañca sādākhyamucyatebhūtabrahmaṃ tṛtīyantu piṇḍabrahmaṃ caturthakamsākalyāditi yatpañca mūrtibrahmaṃ taducyatetasmācchuddhādicātmānaṃ tatvabrahmaṃ prakīrtitamtṛtīyo ṣaṣṭhabhedantu caturthaṃ saptamaṃ tathāmāṃsaṃ vai pārthivaṃ bījaṃ medaso āpa ucyatepañcamaṃ vyomabījaṃ syāt bhūtabrahma prakīrtitamnamaskārānta saṃyuktaṃ sadyādītyucyate kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00254 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karmeśaṃ piṇḍarūpatvāt piṇḍabrahmepyudāhṛtamaghorasya kalāścāṣṭau vāmadeve trayodaśamūrtitatvaṃ tathābhūtaṃ piṇḍaṃ ceti kalā tathāmantrabrahmaṃ kriyābrahmaṃ tatvabrahmeti ca smṛtamīśānaṃ puruṣaṃ caivāpyaghoraṃ vāmameva caāvāhanasthāpanañca sānnidhyaṃ sannirodhanambrahmaviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥlakārañca vakārañca rakārañca yakārakamsadyaṃ vāmamaghorañca puruṣeśānameva caityete pañca bhedatvāt pañcabrahmamudāhṛtambhuvanāni mahattejo saṃjñā pañca labhecchivaḥetāssadāśivāvasthā bhogasthānassamāśritaḥmūrtissadāśivajñeya sarvakāryapravartikāvastutastu na bhinnāste yāto'nanya svaśaktitaḥvyomāstraṃ caivāghorāstraṃ pañcāstrañceti kīrtitamnavārṇaṃ pāśupadaṃ jñeyaṃ vyomāstrantu daśākṣarammokṣadañcābhyavṛddhiñca kāmyaṃ śāntikapauṣṭikamkāmyamaṣṭākṣaraṃ vidyāt śāntikantu navākṣaramete pañca vidhāḥ proktāḥ mantrāḥ pañcākṣarādayaḥliṅgasya sthāpane kāle tatvamantrāśca vinyasettayoryogakriyāvasthā sā pratiṣṭhā prakīrtitāprāṇamantramiti proktaṃ prakṛtiṃ mūrtirucyatetasmādvai mantramūrtiśca liṅgamadhye tu vinyasettatvaṃ savye tu vinyasya dādiṃ vāme tu vinyasetmantranyāsamiti proktaṃ tattvanyāsamihocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00254 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrtiścaivāparenyasyādamūrtiścottare nyasetpañcamūrtimayaṃ devaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇamāvāhayettato devaṃ sa pañcākṣaramaṃtrataḥaṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa sānnidhyakaraṇaṃ kurupādyaṃ gandhādikaṃ dadyāt brahmāṅgaissaha buddhimānkriyāśarīramityuktaṃ mantraṃ jīvamiti smṛtamtasmājjīvaśarīrañca jñātvā karma samācarettṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhiṃ syāt caturthaṃ mantraśodhanamanantākhyāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ siṃhāsanamataḥ parampañcamaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ kalpayedupari kramātdharmajñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca catuṣṭayamśuddhakarmavadākāraṃ yogāsanamiti smṛtamgaṇāṃbikāmuttare tu mahādevīñca pūrvataḥetābhiśśaktibhissārdhaṃ kalpayedvimalāsanamekaikaṃ pañcadhā proktaṃ caturaśrādi bhedataḥpadmā cakrā tathā vedī saumyā ramyā ca pañcamīnirātmā paramātmā ca kathayāmi yathārthataḥidaṃ tasmin sthito devī tadātmā saiva ucyateantarātmā sa vijñeyo nirbandastu śubhāśubhaiḥbāhyātmā tu tadā devī niṣṭhayā bhogabhuk sadāmalakarmaikayuktātmā māyādharmamatiḥ kṛtaḥātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva hiātmānaṃ daṇḍamadhyasthaṃ antarātmā tadanantarambhūtātmā vāmapārśve tu pañcātmā sthānameva catatvātmā amṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śuddhātmā cāntayetpunaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00254 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vijñānakevalaśśuddhaṃ pañcāvasthaḥ pumāṃsmṛtaḥna vijñānakalāstena nāpi pralayakevalaḥtasmātsakala evāyaṃ labhate puruṣāhvayammalakarma mahāmāyamāyorthamakhilaṃ jagatulkāvṛttiṃ tadanteṣu sthitvā sthitvā tadājñayānivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntiranantaramkalā vidyā ca rāgaśca kālo niyatireva caannaprāṇamanojñāna mayā kośāstathātmanaḥannamādimayaṃ devīttyanyonyaṃ sūkṣmarūpakamgṛhṇātyannamayātmānaṃ deho lokāyataḥ khaluvijñānamayamātmānaṃ bandhā gṛhṇanti nāparamahaṅkārātmanātītaṃ prāhuḥ prāyo manomayaḥsamūhaskandhaśabdārthaṃ tattatsantati vācakaḥsaṃskāraskandha ityukto vāsanānantasantatiḥvedānāṃ skandha ityukto saṃjñā syātskandhanāma yatāmapakvamalaṃ garbhaṃ mūtrāśayeti pañcakamvitanyakṣāṇi puṃsārdhāṃ na svayaṃ sopi śaṃbhunāhṛdayādi samārabhya nābhyāntantu suṣuptikamjāgrādi svapnamevaṃ hi pravartakamihocyatesuṣuptau mūrtisaṃjñasyātturye yugmaṃ yathā kramamkintu guhyamidaṃ vakṣye śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarasthūlaṃ jāgramiti jñeyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svapnamihocyatetato'dhikamatītaṃ syā devaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtamsadgurorūpadeśena prakāśenaiva niścayaḥittyetattapaso rūpaṃ sughoraṃ pañcalakṣaṇam

sanskrit: avāntaraśca pañcaite śaivaproktāssamāsataḥanādisaṃjña śaivāste mahāśaivānatha śṛṇumantreśvarāśca mantrāśca mahāśaivaissadeśajāḥrudratvanantaśiṣyāste ādiśaivāḥ prakīrtitāḥṛṣayassiddhagaṃdharva yakṣo rakṣoragādayaḥanuśaivā ime proktā antarān śṛṇu tānvratamdūrvāso'gastya ṛṣikāḥ dadhīcimunivaṃśajāḥatha śaiva samākhyāta kāreṇa tu śivāgameādau sadāśivenaiva dīkṣitāstvādi śaivakāḥagastyaścaiva pañcaite pañcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥcaturthastvanuśaivaśca nṛpo vaiśya iti smṛtaḥlaukikaṃ vaidikañcaiva tathādhyātmikameva calaukikaṃ jyotiṣaṃ jñeyaṃ vaidikaṃ nyāyameva camantrākhyaṃ śuddhaśaivantu pañcavaktrasamudbhavāḥsūtraṃ bhāṣyaṃ vārtikañca vyākhyāprakaraṇaṃ tathāalpākṣaramasaṃdigdhaṃ sāravadviśvato mukhamyatra bījamivārūḍho mahāmaṃtrārthapādapaḥsūtrārtho varṇyate yatra vākyaissūtrānusāribhiḥpadacchedaḥ padārthoktiḥ vigraho vākyayojanāuktānuktadviruktādi cintā yatra pravartateśāstraikadeśa saṃsiddhaṃ śāstrakāryāntare sthitamsargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśamanvantarāṇi capāṭhakṛtvā tu kartavyāḥ padacchedastu dhīmatāsamāsamiti vijñeyaṃ śravaṇaṃ pañcadhā smṛtamvibhakte ca pratīkāra siddhaḥ pañcāṃgamityapi

sanskrit: adivyaśceti pañcaite saṃbandhāḥ parikīrtitāḥdṛṣṭāntopanayāvetau nigamaścātha pañcamaḥdṛṣṭāntastadvidhādyukta hetustadvatpratīkṣatepunaḥ pratijñā niyamo nigamasya sa hetukaḥasiddhaḥ prathamāhetoḥ viruddhaśca dvitīyakaḥkālassatyapadiṣṭaistu pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥāsthāpanaṃ caturthantu proktamutthāpanaṃ tathāyatra brahmaśilāmadhye liṅgamādau vidhāya cakriyate sā pratiṣṭhā syāt sthāpanaṃ kathyate punaḥsthāpyate piṇḍikā madhye sthāpanaṃ tadudīritammanasā yatra saṃskāra sthitasthāpanamucyatesaṃskāra kriyate yatra tadāsthāpanamīritamanyasaṃsthāpite yatra tadutthāpanamucyatevāmajaṃ śayane pañca talpastvete prakīrtitāḥkārpāsena kṛtaṃ yattu muṇḍajaṃ tatprakīrtitamcarmajaṃ vyāghrasihmādi kauśeyaṃ vāmajaṃ smṛtamkalyāṇasundarañcaiva candraśekharameva cavṛṣabhavāhanañcaiva ardhanārīśvaraṃ tathāete vai pañcamūrtistu sthitimūrtirudāhṛtāḥhastamenena nāmāni sa lakṣaṇa samanvitamdvirakṣaṇaṃ rudrasaṃkhyāyāṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ ravisaṃkhyakamprākārāṃ paritaḥ kuryāt prāsādasya pramāṇataḥdaṇḍārdhena kṛtaṃ yattadantarmaṇḍalameva cacaturdaṇḍapramāṇe tu kṛtamaryādikaṃ smṛtamevaṃ prākāramākhyātaṃ gopurasya vidhīyate

sanskrit: prāsādamadhyahārāyāṃ maryādau harmyamucyatejagajjanmasthiti dhvaṃsatirobhāvavimuktayaḥidameva paraṃ divyaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ parikīrtitamjñānayajñastataḥ prokta iti yajñasya pañcakamkarmayajñassamākhyātaḥ tapaścāndrāyaṇādikamdhyānayajñassamākhyāta śivacintā muhurmuhuḥiti pañcaprakāreṇa jñānayajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥyasmāttasmādviśuddhoyaṃ apavargaphalapradāḥjñānābhyāsāt tadā puṃsāṃ buddhirbhavati nirmalādhyānena vividhān bhogān jñānānmuktimavāpnuyātmāheśvareṇa pañcaite pūrvaṃ pūrvaguṇādhikāḥpūjayeddevakalyāṇe pavitrārohaṇādikedeśikohamiti prokto yena tena gururvaraḥtasmādādau tu sarveṣāṃ pūjanīyo yathārhakamputrakātsādhakaśśreṣṭhāt tasmādācārya sattamaḥbhasmaṃ caivādiśaivānāṃ pañcamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥpañcamudradharāssarve bhavanti kvacidāgameakṣasūtrañca pañcaite yogīnāṃ yogapañcakamromayajñopavītañca pañcamudrā mahāvratehemayajñopavītañca pañcāṃgabhūṣaṇaṃ tathātathā mauravikaścaiva pañcācāryāḥ prakīrtitāḥbhāvanāgeyanṛttādi vādyajñānaviśāradāḥteṣu śreṣṭha iti proktā nartako nartaśāstravitpañcācāryāśca matkanya devadāsyaśca vādakāḥanuktānāmato'nyeṣāṃ tattatkarmānusārataḥ

sanskrit: iti gomātaḥ pañca śivalokavyavasthitāḥpañcagavyamiti proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanamgomūtraṃ gomayālābhe tadalābhe tu gomayaḥdīkṣānte ca pratiṣṭhānte pavitrānte ca kārayetyaḥ pibecca tato bhaktyā śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajetśivapriyaṃ viśeṣeṇa śivapūjāṃ samācaretpañcāmṛtamiti proktaṃ pañcapātakanāśanamkoṣṭhaṃ pātrañca maṃtrāṇi pūrvavatparikalpayetāmrakaṃ mātuluṅgañca ete pañcaphalā smṛtāḥgoṣpadasparśanāntañca pañcaite sthānaśuddhayaḥpañcopacāra ete syuḥ dīpāntaṃ vāpi saṃmatamvahnestu nāmakaraṇaṃ pañcasaṃskārakaṃ bhavetśubhaṃ pāśapratyayañca paśupratyayakaṃ tathākuṃbhasarpavidhiścaiva pañcapratyayamīritamaṅgāre sūryavāre ca kārayeddeśikassadāsatyamuddiśya yaddravyaṃ dharmārthāya nivedayettannivṛttā iti prokta padārthaḥ ṣaṭsamācaretlayabhogādhikārākhyaṃ stritatvokti nidarśanātbhogyabhoktṛtvasaṃbandha māyādhārasurañciteśaktyākhyassaṃpadārthoyaḥ dvitīyaḥ paribhāṣyatesapadārthaṃ triparvoyaṃ tṛtīyaśśivasādhanepadārthapaśunāmāsau caturtho munipuṃgavasādhyasādhanabhāvena saṃsthitā ye parasparamye mantraḥ śuddhamārgasthā śivabhaṭṭākarādayaḥpādatrayeṣu sopānaḥ saṃsāroddhārakāraṇam
